description: Preflight an unfamiliar public URL or API before an AI agent relies on it. It performs one live fetch and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict with HTTP status, content type, response time, final URL/redirect behavior, auth and rate-limit signals, and a short response sample. A PASS proves only that this fetch succeeded at check time; it does not validate authenticated flows, POST side effects, JavaScript execution, or business logic.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain to probe. Bare domains like google.com are accepted and normalized to https:// automatically.

name: check_endpoint

accessible.description: True when the endpoint returned a 2xx HTTP status.

authRequired.description: True when the server responded with 401 or 403, which usually means credentials are required.

error.description: Validation or network error when the request could not be completed.

evidence.description: Structured observations used to produce the verdict.

finalUrl.description: Final response URL when the runtime exposes it.

inputUrl.description: Original user input when normalization changed it, for example when https:// was added.

next_step.description: Agent-readable follow-up for sources that should remain trustworthy over time.

rateLimited.description: True when the server responded with 429 Too Many Requests.

recommended_action.description: Suggested next step based only on observed response behavior.

redirected.description: True when the fetch followed a redirect to a different final URL.

sampleResponse.description: First 1,000 characters of the response body for quick inspection. Use this as a debugging hint only; it may be truncated and should not be treated as a complete page capture.

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the endpoint, when a response was received.

summary.description: Short human-readable explanation of the verdict.

url.description: Normalized URL that was actually fetched.

verdict.description: Operational preflight verdict. It is evidence for an agent decision, not a security guarantee.

title: Endpoint Reachability Check
